_: behaviour -> the test(s) that name it. Same shape as kit-hosted.tests.json: the corpus carries the mapping, keyed on file + title (a vitest title is the exact it() string, without its describe() prefix).
_authored: 2026-10-13, by reading kit-ui.beh against the UI's vitest suite (claude-code-bot#105). Only behaviours whose then-steps or main contract a test ASSERTS are mapped; pending ones stay unmapped, so `kit check kit-ui` keeps naming them. BEH-SHEET-1 had no asserting test and got one in the same change.
_honest: A mapping entry is a HUMAN'S CLAIM that the named test asserts the behaviour. kit check proves the test exists, not what it asserts. Several entries cover the contract rather than every then-step (PAIR-1 and STEP-1 do not assert their headings; NAV-1 does not click through).

BEH-LIST-1.title: lists every corpus the read API returned
reports a corpus that will not parse as an error, not as zero behaviours

BEH-SHEET-1.title: shows the question sheet Kit built for a project, with its review queue and the way to ask for more

BEH-SCHED-1.title: with nothing scheduled, says nothing is next and lists the backlog
shows a built or vanished entry as such rather than dropping it, and neither is next

BEH-SCHED-2.title: schedules a backlog behaviour, which moves across and is marked next
moves a behaviour up, and the top is next

BEH-SCHED-3.title: moves a behaviour up, and the top is next
with nothing scheduled, says nothing is next and lists the backlog

BEH-BOARD-3.title: puts the top of a schedule in progress and the rest of it in Scheduled, in schedule order (BEH-BOARD-3)

BEH-BOARD-4.title: orders Done most recently completed first, across projects (BEH-BOARD-4)
keeps every card when a history cannot be read, says so, and puts them after the dated ones

BEH-PAIR-1.title: shows the behaviour and the test Kit generated from it, together

BEH-ADJ-1.title: approves it, then re-reads so the corpus on screen is the corpus on disk

BEH-ADJ-2.title: will not deny without the correction, and sends it when there is one

BEH-STEP-1.title: POSTs the line as typed, then re-reads so the regenerated test is what you see

BEH-NOTE-1.title: sends the text as typed, then re-reads so the new note is in the list, and says what git did
will not send an empty note

BEH-NOTE-2.title: on a behaviour page, tags the note with that behaviour and lists only its notes

BEH-NOTE-3.title: says there are no open notes rather than showing nothing
lists every open note on the project page, with the behaviour each one names

BEH-NOTE-4.title: asks for a new behaviour in prose: no id, title or actor, and nothing sent while it is blank

BEH-NOTE-5.title: puts a note with questions under "Needs your answer", numbered, and not in the open list too
shows no "Needs your answer" at all when nothing is waiting

BEH-NOTE-6.title: answers a note by its place in the FILE and its date, then it leaves "Needs your answer"

BEH-NOTE-7.title: dismisses a note in one tap, by its place and date
says why a dismissal was refused, on the card it was pressed on

BEH-NOTE-8.title: resolves a decision in prose, as a note naming its key, never as corpus syntax

BEH-TITLE-1.title: links a card to its behaviour page and names its project

BEH-NAV-1.title: links the board and the projects and marks the current view

BEH-BOARD-1.title: puts each behaviour in the column for where it stands
puts a denied inference on no column
names a corpus that will not parse, not drops it

BEH-BOARD-2.title: colours and filters by project, so files naming one # kit:project share a button and a colour
hides trial corpora until asked, and records the ask in the url
filters to the selected projects, in the url

BEH-FEAT-1.title: BEH-FEAT-1: a project shows its top-level features, then only its untagged behaviours
BEH-FEAT-1: a project with no features lists every behaviour, as before

BEH-FEAT-2.title: BEH-FEAT-2: a feature lists what is tagged into it and every parent as a tag
BEH-FEAT-2: one behaviour tagged into two features is listed under both

BEH-FEAT-3.title: BEH-FEAT-3: the crumbs are the path in the url, and a child link carries it on
BEH-FEAT-3: with no path the crumbs are the project and the feature, never a picked parent

BEH-FEAT-4.title: BEH-FEAT-4: files naming one project are one card with one link; a file of its own reads as before

BEH-FEAT-5.title: draws every file’s features together, each linking into its own file, and names no file
